summary: IEEE-library form of relay coil with diode and led: a relay assembly with diode and LED combines coil transient suppression and a visible energisation indicator.
description: This reference locates relay coil with diode and led in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented relays with suppression family. A relay assembly with diode and LED combines coil transient suppression and a visible energisation indicator. The schematic must identify both auxiliary functions without treating the LED as proof of contact movement. The public library uses HCR1K35 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

The indicator reports its own electrical condition, not necessarily the mechanical contact state. An illuminated coil indicator is different from an auxiliary contact confirming device position. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
